create_llama4_model: create a Llama 4 TransformerLM model from a Llama4Config using the factory function
create_llama4_self_attention: create a StandardMultiheadAttention layer with chunked local or global attention bias for a given layer index
create_llama4_ffn: create a GLU feed-forward network or MoE expert layer depending on the interleave step configuration
create_llama4_layer_norm: create an RMSNorm layer normalization module with elementwise affine for the model dimension
create_llama4_qk_norm: create an RMSNorm QK normalization layer without bias or elementwise affine for a given dimension
